name: Magic Melon | Melted Diamond Live Resin Vaporizer | 1.0g (Reload)
description:
DIAMONDS INSIDE 
Our live resin diamonds, extracted from fresh frozen flowers, use a gradual separation process creating large faceted diamond-like crystals. The 99%+ potency diamond crystals are then liquefied, producing the highest potency vaporizers on the market.

Magic Melon
Juicy, sweet, and refreshingly smooth — Magic Melon lives up to its name with a vibrant flavor profile that’s all melon at first puff. Hints of tropical fruit and subtle herbal undertones add depth to its lush, candy-like aroma.
